turnLog.tail: The grep revealed hundreds of recurring "BUG-TRACE" scheduler retry warnings in logs/debug.log, and reading src/utils/format.js exposed the culprit: `formatPercent` uses `.toFixed(0)` instead of one decimal place, so it rounds 0.2875 to "29%" instead of "28.8%".

Fixed: `formatPercent` in `src/utils/format.js` now rounds to one decimal place using explicit round-half-up (`Math.round(x * 1000) / 10`) before formatting, which handles the floating-point edge case where 0.2875 × 100 = 28.75 would otherwise round down to "28.7" — and `node test/run-tests.js` now prints **ALL TESTS PASSED**.
